_comment: Precision baseline for the held-out false-positive corpus.
Every entry here is a KNOWN DEFECT, not an allowance. The target is an empty
'known_false_positives' object. validate_precision_floor.py fails on any finding
not recorded here, and also fails when a recorded finding disappears -- that
second direction is deliberate, so fixing a detector forces you to ratchet this
file down rather than leaving stale slack in the gate.
Do not add entries to make CI pass. An entry means a detector is wrong.

NO_ACCESS_CONTROL_MUTATION.why_wrong: Flags `deposit` and `withdraw`, which are intentionally permissionless user entrypoints. The detector treats any external function that writes storage without a caller check as an access-control defect, which describes most legitimate DeFi entrypoints.
Flags `record_batch`, a permissionless batch-recording entrypoint. Same root cause as above.
